title: Power- and Fragmentation-aware Online Scheduling for GPU Datacenters
abstract: arXiv:2412.17484v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rise of Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models is driving increased GPU usage in data centers for complex training and inference tasks, impacting operational costs, energy demands, and the environmental footprint of large-scale computing infrastructures. This work addresses the online scheduling problem in GPU datacenters, which involves scheduling tasks without knowledge of their future arrivals. We focus on two objectives: minimizing GPU fragmentation and reducing power consumption. GPU fragmentation occurs when partial GPU allocations hinder the efficient use of remaining resources, especially as the datacenter nears full capacity. A recent scheduling policy, Fragmentation Gradient Descent (FGD), leverages a fragmentation metric to address this issue. Reducing power consumption is also crucial due to the significant power demands of GPUs. To this end, we propose PWR, a novel scheduling policy to minimize power

translated_title: 面向GPU数据中心的功耗与碎片感知在线调度
translated_abstract: 人工智能和大语言模型的兴起正在推动数据中心增加GPU的使用，以应对复杂的训练和推理任务，这影响了运营成本、能源需求以及大规模计算基础设施的环境足迹。本工作研究GPU数据中心的在线调度问题，即在不知道任务未来到达情况下调度任务。我们关注两个目标：最小化GPU碎片化和降低功耗。GPU碎片化是指部分GPU分配阻碍了剩余资源的有效利用，尤其是当数据中心接近满负荷时。最近的一种调度策略——碎片化梯度下降（FGD），利用碎片化度量来解决这一问题。由于GPU的巨大功耗需求，降低功耗也至关重要。为此，我们提出了PWR，一种旨在最小化功耗的新型调度策略。
tldr: 该论文提出了PWR，一种面向GPU数据中心的功耗与碎片感知在线调度策略，在不预知未来任务到达的情况下降低功耗并缓解GPU碎片化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PWR, a power- and fragmentation-aware online scheduling policy for GPU datacenters that reduces power consumption and mitigates GPU fragmentation without knowledge of future task arrivals.
